instructions: 1. Run `GH_REPO=owner/repo gh stack merge 632 --yes --squash` in `owner/repo` to merge PRs #631, #632 of stack #63. #633 stays open above it (not owned); GitHub retargets it onto `main`. One command lands every listed layer. Do not merge the layers one at a time with `gh pr merge`, and do not rebase or push between layers; GitHub retargets the remaining layers itself. If `gh stack` is an unknown command, run `gh extension install github/gh-stack`, then rerun that merge command.

2. After the merge attempt, rerun `pr-shepherd stack https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/631 https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/632 --until-terminal --merge-through https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/632`; GitHub retargets the next layer onto `main`. Shepherd any layer that GitHub rejects or ejects.
